system_prompt: You extract structured information from FDA drug labels. Only use information present in the text.

contraindications.description: Absolute prohibitions: conditions under which the drug must never be used (from CONTRAINDICATIONS on Rx labels or DO_NOT_USE on OTC labels), e.g. known allergy to an ingredient. Empty list if the label has none.
contraindications.title: Contraindications

cautions.description: Conditions requiring care or a doctor's advice before use (ASK_DOCTOR, WARNINGS), e.g. pregnancy or breast-feeding, liver disease.
cautions.title: Cautions

stop_use_conditions.description: Situations in which the user should stop taking the drug (STOP_USE), e.g. symptoms persist more than N days.
stop_use_conditions.title: Stop Use Conditions

indications.description: Specific medical conditions or symptoms this product treats or relieves. Look in INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE and PURPOSE sections. Exclude non-informative phrases such as 'condition listed above' or 'as directed by the physician'. Each item must be an independently meaningful condition (e.g. 'acne', not 'temporary relief').
indications.title: Indications

safety.description: Safety statements about the patient. Never include packaging, tamper seals, storage, 'external use only', or 'keep out of reach of children'.

dosage_form.description: Physical form of the product as administered, taken from dosage or administration text (e.g. 'dissolve under the tongue' pellets => pellet). Not the plant part or raw ingredient. Null if not stated.
dosage_form.title: Dosage Form

INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE:
INDICATIONS Indications: MEZEREUM Itching

PURPOSE:
USES To relieve the symptoms of itching.

WARNINGS:
STOP USE AND ASK DOCTOR If symptoms persist/worsen or if pregnant/nursing, stop use and consult your practitioner.

DOSAGE_AND_ADMINISTRATION:
DIRECTIONS Adults: Dissolve 3 to 5 under the tongue three times a day or as directed by Lic. Practitioner. Take at greater intervals as condition subsides. Children: Dissolve 3 to 5 under the tongue three times a day or as directed by Lic. Practitioner. Take at greater intervals as condition subsides.

INDICATIONS_AND_USAGE:
INDICATIONS AND USAGE Ofloxacin ophthalmic solution is indicated for the treatment of infections caused by susceptible strains of the following bacteria in the conditions listed below:

CONTRAINDICATIONS:
CONTRAINDICATIONS Ofloxacin ophthalmic solution is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to ofloxacin, to other quinolones, or to any of the components in this medication (see WARNINGS ).

WARNINGS:
WARNINGS NOT FOR INJECTION. Ofloxacin ophthalmic solution should not be injected subconjunctivally, nor should it be introduced directly into the anterior chamber of the eye. There are rare reports of anaphylactic reaction/shock and fatal hypersensitivity reactions in patients receiving systemic quinolones, some following the first dose, including ofloxacin. Some reactions were accompanied by cardiovascular collapse, loss of consciousness, angioedema (including laryngeal, pharyngeal or facial edema), airway obstruction, dyspnea, urticaria, and itching. A rare occurrence of Stevens-Johnson syndrome, which progressed to toxic epidermal necrolysis, has been reported in a patient who was receiving topical ophthalmic ofloxacin. If an allergic reaction to ofloxacin occurs, discontinue the drug. Serious acute hypersensitivity reactions may require immediate emergency treatment. Oxygen and airway management, including intubation should be administered as clinically indicated.

DOSAGE_AND_ADMINISTRATION:
DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The recommended dosage regimen for the treatment of bacterial conjunctivitis is: Days 1 and 2 Instill one to two drops every two to four hours in the affected eye(s). Days 3 through 7 Instill one to two drops four times daily. The recommended dosage regimen for the treatment of bacterial corneal ulcer is: Days 1 and 2 Instill one to two drops into the affected eye every 30 minutes, while awake. Awaken at approximately four and six hours after retiring and instill one to two drops. Days 3 through 7 to 9 Instill one to two drops hourly, while awake. Days 7 to 9 through treatment completion Instill one to two drops, four times daily.

indications: treatment of infections caused by susceptible strains of bacteria in bacterial conjunctivitis
